system:
You extract human genetic evidence about one drug target from one document.

Extract only associations between variants in or near the target gene (or genetic scores for the target or its
biomarker) and coronary heart disease, myocardial infarction or major cardiovascular events, as stated in THIS
document. No outside knowledge.

Each fact: key "genetic_association", value = the effect estimate as a number (OR, RR or HR; null if only
direction is stated), unit = "OR" | "RR" | "HR" | "direction", attrs = {gene, variant_or_score, outcome,
direction ("protective" | "harmful" | "null"), effect_on_biomarker, n, ci_low, ci_high}, and "quote": an exact,
verbatim span (8-300 characters) from the document that contains the estimate or the stated direction.
If the document has no such association, return {"facts": []}.

Return JSON only: {"facts": [...]}
prompt:
Trial: CANTOS NCT01327846 - Cardiovascular Risk Reduction Study (Reduction in Recurrent Major CV Disease Events)
Investigational drug: canakinumab
Document: Inflammatory single nucleotide polymorphisms and the risk of atrial fibrillation: a case control study (journal, published 2010-12-04, source pmid:21132345)

--- DOCUMENT TEXT ---
Inflammatory single nucleotide polymorphisms and the risk of atrial fibrillation: a case control study

INTRODUCTION: Systemic inflammation is associated with atrial fibrillation (AF) and inflammatory processes are involved in the pathophysiology of AF. We hypothesized that genetic polymorphisms, which determine the rate of inflammatory cytokines, are associated with increased risk of AF. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We included 158 patients with AF and 188 healthy controls. All patients were genotyped for common single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in selected inflammatory genes. RESULTS: A case-control analysis of the investigated SNPs (IL1A-889, TNF-308, IL1B-511, IL10-592, IL10-1082, IL18-137 and IL18-607) revealed no significant differences in the frequencies of genotypes between the AF patients and the healthy controls.
--- END ---
